title: Finite-sheet coordinates for the two canonical adjunction maps
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a normed extension of Q_ℓ, and p:U→X finite etale surjective. Given a pro-etale locally finite free rational P, a pro-etale locally finite free integral M and e:Ext(M)≅p^*P, there is a pro-etale cover with compact members and, on each member, finite ranks r,n,m, a mono rational map i:F(O^r)→F(O^n) with cokernel isomorphic to F(O^m), and three integral-module coordinate isomorphisms eA,eB,eD. They identify the normalized restrictions of Res(P), p_*M and Res(p_*p^*P) with G(F(O^r)), O^n and G(F(O^n)), respectively. The first identifies the restricted rational adjunction unit with G(i), and the second identifies the restricted pushed lattice embedding with the localization unit O^n→G(F(O^n)). Here F⊣G is the coefficient extension/restriction adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients] and both canonical maps are those of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-lattice-intersection]. No intersection, kernel, local freeness of an intersection or descent conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the finite-etale local-freeness models to the integral module M and rational module P. This gives free covers for B=p_*M and Q=coker(P to p_*p^*P). Refine these with the supplied cover of P, then by affine opens to get compact members. Reuse the free_map, free_comap, free_pullback and free_pullback_comp_iff lemmas of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CondensedConstructibleSerre for transport of finite freeness, rather than reproving them. The coordinate module also reuses the normalized free_standardPullback lemma of FiniteEtaleLocallyFreeModels.

The weakly-etale localization functor of a surjective quasi-compact map is cover dense, hence its restriction on abelian sheaves is faithful. Transfer this to module inverse image through the forgetful comparison. Faithfulness and the adjunction triangle make the unit mono.

The adjoint of the pushed lattice embedding is an isomorphism: the integral scalar/pushforward comparison and e identify its rational extension with p_*p^*P. The rationalization equation of the lattice embedding specifies this adjoint.

Show the pulled adjoint is an isomorphism using the prime-localization telescope. Normalized inverse image preserves its colimit. Transport the original localization colimit through the original adjoint isomorphism and the coefficient comparison. The zeroth-leg equation and uniqueness of all localization legs give an isomorphism between the two colimit cocones.

Choose the three finite free bases on the common compact cover. The integral basis gives eB; the rational basis and scalar extension of regular modules give eA. The inverse pulled-adjoint isomorphism followed by extension of eB gives eD. Conjugate the pulled rational unit to define i. Monicity and the chosen quotient basis give its finite free cokernel. Naturality of the coefficient comparison proves the first equation; the adjunction unit and its naturality prove the second. Both coordinate equations are applications of private general categorical naturality lemmas, proved in the same module to avoid unfolding the concrete functors in the equality calculations.

theorem continuousLatticeIntersection_splitData
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod _).obj P))
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
    (hM : ∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage U, ∀ s : D.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) U))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      CompactSpace (C.X s) ∧
      let R := condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.X s)
      let T := (ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) ⋙
        Mod.comap (inv (condensedPullbackHom (integralCoeff ℓ E) (C.f s)))
      let F := Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      let G := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (C.X s)) Ab.{u + 1})
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      let adj := Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
        (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (C.X s))
      ∃ (r n m : ℕ) (i : F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R r) ⟶ F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R n)),
        Mono i ∧ Nonempty (cokernel i ≅ F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R m)) ∧
        ∃ (eA : T.obj ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj P) ≅
              G.obj (F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R r)))
          (eB : T.obj ((lowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) p).obj M) ≅ Mod.finiteFree R n)
          (eD : T.obj ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).obj
              ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj
                ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P))) ≅
              G.obj (F.obj (Mod.finiteFree R n))),
          eA.hom ≫ G.map i =
            T.map (latticeIntersectionUnit (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X P p) ≫ eD.hom ∧
          eB.hom ≫ adj.unit.app (Mod.finiteFree R n) =
            T.map (latticePushedEmbedding (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X P p M e) ≫ eD.hom
